tweets.text:
i see NFTs finding a new role as more businesses and financial assets move onchain

tokenized stocks, RWAs and stablecoins are creating new infrastructure, and NFTs can become another layer around ownership, access and community

the NFT + fungible token hybrid idea has already been tested before without really taking off

the concept is worth revisiting though: liquid tokens for broad participation, with NFTs representing a more specialized tier of ownership or benefits

that feels like a more interesting direction for NFTs this cycle
